    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Figure-eight_knot_(mathematics)
    FigureEightKnot(t: Angle): Point3D
        => ((2.0 + (t * 2.0).Cos) * (t * 3.0).Cos,
            (2.0 + (t * 2.0).Cos) * (t * 3.0).Sin,
            (t * 4.0).Sin);
